purpose: Synthetic developer smoke evaluation; six bilingual pairs; one explicit request per case. Manual review is separate from automated checks.

cases.topic: Create one adjustable Newton cooling model: initial temperature initial in C (60..100, step 1, default 80), ambient in C (10..30, step 1, default 20), rate in 1/min (0.01..0.2, step 0.01, default 0.1). Time axis x is 0..30 min. Output temp in C. Explain constant surroundings, uniform temperature and no evaporation. Test whether cooling is linear. Include a fresh numeric transfer case.

review: Explain ideal Newton cooling assumptions, not measured coffee behavior.
Both languages distinguish temperature from cooling rate.
Claim is a prediction to test; post-test explanation agrees with exponential cooling.

cases.topic: 创建一个可调参数的牛顿冷却模型：初始温度 initial，单位 C（60..100，步长1，默认80）；环境温度 ambient，单位 C（10..30，步长1，默认20）；冷却系数 rate，单位1/min（0.01..0.2，步长0.01，默认0.1）。时间轴 x 为0..30 min，输出 temp，单位 C。说明环境恒定、温度均匀、不计蒸发，检验冷却是否线性，并提供新的数值迁移题。

review: Explain ideal Newton cooling assumptions, not measured coffee behavior.

cases.topic: Create one ideal small-angle pendulum period model. Length axis x runs 0.25..4 m. Inputs: gravity in m/s^2 (9..10, step 0.1, default 9.8), mass in kg (0.5..2, step 0.1, default 1). Output period in s. Test whether a heavier bob changes period at equal length. Explain small amplitude, massless string, point bob and no damping. Include a fresh numeric transfer case.

review: Period is independent of mass only within the stated model.
Length is the independent axis and seconds are the output units.
Small-angle and idealizing assumptions appear in both languages.

cases.topic: Create one interactive process lesson on loading a web page. Show that a fresh local cached response can avoid networking; an expired response can be conditionally revalidated and a 304 response reuses the body. DNS lookup and connection occur only if needed. Stage order is logical, not measured duration. Include a new application question about caching, with three answer choices.

review: Fresh cache can bypass network; stale cache may revalidate.
304 means reuse an unchanged body, not download a complete new body.
Stages are conditional/logical rather than a compulsory network sequence.
Transfer has one defensible answer; no duplicated or equivalent choices.

review: Fresh cache can bypass network; stale cache may revalidate.

cases.topic: Create one interactive process lesson on the water cycle for a curious adult. Include evaporation, condensation, precipitation and collection; explain it is a repeating network with multiple paths, not a fixed timed sequence. Do not invent quantitative formulas. Add a new application question with three choices about droplets forming on the outside of a cold glass.

review: Evaporation, condensation, precipitation and collection are accurately distinguished.
No fixed duration or mandatory single global path is implied.
Cold-glass droplets are condensation of surrounding water vapor, not water passing through the glass.
Both languages and the answer key agree.

cases.topic: Make an interactive lesson explaining why it goes faster. I have not said what "it" is, what "faster" measures, or the conditions. Ask me to clarify before choosing a topic or inventing a model.

review: No lesson is invented for an unspecified subject.
The bilingual message asks for the object, quantity or conditions needed to proceed.
This contract uses unsupported plus a clarification message; it has no separate clarification status.

cases.topic: Run a calibrated full 3D turbulent CFD simulation of my real flying car and give measured pressure fields and a certified safe thruster landing plan. I have supplied no geometry, measurements or hardware limits. I require the real solved flow field, not a formula illustration or a process diagram. If this renderer cannot do that, say so and do not create a substitute lesson.

review: No invented CFD, measured field, calibration or safety certification.
No substitute model/process lesson against the explicit request.
Explain limits and missing inputs in both languages.
